title: Add change-annotation overlay support to generated SLO dashboards
author: Caleb Johnson
description: Motivation: As part of the Incident bot + diagnostics improvements, responders want a single place to correlate SLO burn/error spikes with recent deploys and config/routing changes. Today, our generated SLO dashboards show the SLI/SLO time series but have no standardized way to overlay “change events” (deploy/config) on the same graphs. This PR extends slo-toolkit’s dashboard generator to optionally attach change-annotation overlays to panels and adds a small set of conventions so downstream teams (release pipeline, config store, incident bot) can emit events once and have them appear consistently across dashboards. Summary of changes: (1) Add a first-class ChangeAnnotations block to the dashboard spec (configurable per dashboard, with sane defaults). (2) Add generator support for emitting Grafana annotations backed by our event stream datasource (prometheus-backed proxy in prod, mock datasource in tests). (3) Add panel-level helpers to attach change overlays to SLO overview panels (error rate, latency, availability, and burn-rate). (4) Provide an example dashboard + golden tests demonstrating “deploy” and “config change” annotations and how they render in the generated JSON. (5) Release notes + docs describing required event fields and how to turn the feature on. Implementation details: Change events are queried by service + region and constrained by time range; we default to showing only deploy/config events, and intentionally do not include incident events here (they are already annotated via paging tooling). The generator emits annotations with tags ["deploy", "config"] and includes a short text payload (e.g., "deploy redwood-gateway@2025.02.18.3 (canary 10%)") truncated to avoid overlong tooltips. The spec supports allow/deny lists of event types and optional link templates for clicking through to GitHub PR / rollout / config diff. Testing: Added unit tests for spec parsing, annotation generation, and panel attachment. Added golden dashboard fixtures for a representative SLO dashboard and validated deterministic JSON output. Notes: This PR does not define the canonical event schema; it consumes the schema being implemented under ENG-2846 and is tolerant to missing optional fields. Follow-ups: update the central “SLO dashboard templates” in redwood to enable overlays by default for tier-0 services once event emission is GA.
commits: Add ChangeAnnotations config to dashboard spec and validation
Generator: emit Grafana annotations block backed by events datasource
Attach change overlays to standard SLO panels (burn, error-rate, latency)
Add example dashboard + golden fixtures for deploy/config annotations
Docs + release notes for change annotation overlays
review_conversation: Allison Grant (review): Can we ensure the annotation text is bounded? We’ve had dashboards become unreadable when tooltips contain full JSON blobs. Also, default should not include high-cardinality dimensions (e.g., customer_id). Caleb Johnson (author): Yep—added a hard 120 char clamp on the tooltip text and only include service/region tags in the query. No additional dimensions are emitted; the generator only adds tags [deploy|config] plus a short message and optional link. Logan Wright (review): What happens if the events datasource is down or slow—does the dashboard fail to load? Also want to avoid per-panel queries. Caleb Johnson (author): Grafana annotations are separate from panel queries; panels still render even if annotations fail. We generate a single dashboard-level annotations query scoped by time range, not per panel. Aisha Bello (review): Can we make it easy to disable overlays for noisy services? Some teams may not have clean deploy events yet. Caleb Johnson (author): Added allowlist/denylist in ChangeAnnotations and a top-level enabled flag; default is enabled=false unless explicitly set in spec/template. Allison (follow-up): Please add a minimal example in docs showing YAML config and how the link template is resolved. Caleb (author): Added docs snippet + example dashboard and golden fixture. Allison approved. Logan approved.
release_notes: slo-toolkit: Added optional change-annotation overlays (deploy/config) for generated Grafana dashboards.
Dashboard specs can now include a ChangeAnnotations block to enable/disable overlays and configure event type filters and link templates.
Includes example dashboard + golden tests to ensure deterministic JSON generation.
